name: Bone ’ead level 7
summary: Bone ’ead; Once per short rest, when you or an ally within 10 ft fails a Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw against fear, psychic manipulation, confusion, or Suppression, you may use your reaction to let that creature reroll the save.
